How to install  Unix command "mail".?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hi, Velappan:

The R code uses the Unix command "mail".  My best guess is that the error means that the "mail" command is not available to you on that machine.  You might try typing 

> man mail

at a Unix (not R) prompt to see if the manual page appears.  If it does not, you'd have to talk to the administrator of the machine about installing that command.

Hope this helps,
RTM
